codeSnippets.code:
Sub RunReconciliationEngine()
    ' Initialize Dictionary for fast in-memory matching
    Dim dictSales As Object
    Set dictSales = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    
    ' Load raw data into variant arrays to bypass slow sheet interactions
    Dim rawData As Variant
    rawData = Sheets("RawSales").Range("A1:F16000").Value
    
    ' Build index
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 2 To UBound(rawData, 1)
        If Not dictSales.exists(rawData(i, 1)) Then
            dictSales.Add rawData(i, 1), rawData(i, 6) ' Map ID to Revenue
        End If
    Next i
    
    ' Perform matching against operational records in milliseconds
    Dim opData As Variant
    opData = Sheets("Operations").Range("A1:C5000").Value
    
    For i = 2 To UBound(opData, 1)
        If dictSales.exists(opData(i, 1)) Then
            opData(i, 3) = dictSales(opData(i, 1)) ' Inject matched data
        Else
            opData(i, 3) = "Unmatched"
        End If
    Next i
    
    ' Write back in one batch operation
    Sheets("Operations").Range("A1:C5000").Value = opData
End Sub

posts.content:
Just delivered a project that achieved 95%+ Processing Time Reduction with the Enterprise Sales & Operations Reconciliation System! 🚀

Before this, the baseline process was a massive operational bottleneck.

Instead of relying on slow, error-prone manual work, I engineered a robust solution using Excel VBA, Data Pipeline, Process Automation.

Designed a fully automated, one-click VBA application to consolidate internal operational records with daily sales transaction data. The solution replaces a highly manual, error-prone daily task with a robust, scalable macro that cleans, filters, and matches multiple data sources in seconds.

⚙️ How it works under the hood:
⚡ Data Ingestion → Automatically reads and imports multiple source files from shared directories
⚡ Intelligent Cleaning → Strips out empty records and dynamically filters non-essential data columns
⚡ Data Reconciliation → Processes structured matching logic to reliably cross-reference operational IDs with corresponding sales
⚡ Final Reporting → Outputs a clean, standardized, and audit-ready dataset for stakeholders

📈 The Impact:
Reduced processing time by over 95%, completely eliminating manual copy-paste errors and filtering inconsistencies. This optimization freed the operations team to focus on higher-value data analysis.

✅ Processed robust datasets of ~16,000 rows across all cleaning, validating, and matching stages in just 10-15 seconds
✅ Reduced the baseline manual file configuration and data parsing time from 30-60 minutes down to zero

💡 Key Takeaway: One of the biggest hurdles was developing extremely fast dictionary-based cross-referencing to match operational ids against dynamic locations without relying on slow vlookup functions. Overcoming this taught me how crucial efficient data structures are when scaling operations.
